help:
VERBS

  LOOK                      the room
  EXAMINE <thing>  (X)      look at it. Looking twice is not the same as looking once.
  TAKE <thing>              some things can be carried
  FILE <clue>               file to the cogitator. Indexed, actionable, and reachable.
  NOTE <clue>               write it in your own notebook. Inert, useless, and yours.
  CLUES                     what you hold, and where you are holding it
  READ ROOM                 when you have enough of it
  QUERY <code>              Lexicanum Vault, by shelf-address
  NOTES                     your case-notes, as the cogitator has them
  NOTEBOOK                  your notebook, as you wrote it

  GO <place>                elsewhere. The clock does not stop for the lift.
  ASK <person> ABOUT <x>    nothing is listed. Name it.
  SHOW <clue> TO <person>   put it in front of them and watch
  DETAIN / PROMISE / DEFY   some verbs belong to the person, not the terminal

  WAIT                      time passes either way
  QUIT

Clue IDs look like A1, A3. FILE A1. NOTE A3. Most clues answer to a plain
word as well.
no_such_thing: There is nothing here by that name, and you have looked.
already_read: You have read it. Reading it a third time is not investigation, it is standing in a dead man's room refusing to leave.
no_such_exit: You cannot get there from here, or not in the time you have.
no_such_topic: You would have to know what you were asking for.
body_removed_elsewhere:
Somewhere above you, at the eighth minute, the medicae take him.

You are not there. Nobody sends word, because nobody has been told to, and the first you will know of it is the empty floor.
read_room_locked:
You do not have enough of this room to read it.

Signs are facts about the place you found them in. Whatever you are carrying, you did not find it here.
read_room_prompt:
You stop moving and let the room assemble itself.

READ ROOM FORWARD  — take the signs in the order he set them down
READ ROOM BACKWARD — take them the other way
no_terminal:
There is no cogitator here.

You have an authority-key in your coat that opens every terminal in the Adamant Crown, and the nearest one is a lift ride away, and that is the whole of the difference between having authority and being able to use it.
no_one_here: There is nobody here to ask.
not_here: There is nobody here by that name.
not_talking: They are here. They are not taking questions, and this is not the moment to make them.
